font.reason: Neutral product/metric voice; variable font so the original fw800 exists; real Persian digit glyphs; replaces Helvetica/Arial.

comps.translatedSummary: Title «رول ارقام کیلومترشمار»; metric ۹۹٫۹۸٪ rolling Persian digit strips.

rtlDecisions.what: Digit order in 99.98 and the left-to-right lock stagger (20/27/34/41)
rtlDecisions.why: Numeral order inside a number is never reversed; the stagger follows digit significance and right-to-left would read as counting backwards
Logically the percent sign follows the number; visually it sits at its left end, via an RTL flex row holding the number as an LTR island

Persian digits via faDigits, percent «٪»; no tabular-nums (cells fixed 150px, no jitter). Decimal separator is drawn as a dot+tail shape on the baseline because Vazirmatn's ٫ renders as a huge slash at 209px

rtlDecisions.what: Vertical roll, overshoot, ghost copies, centre-origin pulse scale, centred label bars
rtlDecisions.why: Physical/vertical or symmetric, carries no reading direction
fs() 1.1x scale for Persian x-height; letterSpacing 0 (title had -1)
Persian digit glyphs at fs(190) are wider than the original cell and were clipped by overflow:hidden (visible on f38/f45)
Persian line-height 1.5 enlarges the line box; offset reduced to keep the same optical top margin

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets in this card.
concerns: Registry duration is 63 frames; design length 150 checked with --duration 150.
